name: 乗継経路の要約
prompt:
Create attempt 2 for LH14-0001, static Japanese route summary, exact 390:120 aspect ratio. This is the second and final generation attempt.

SOURCE AND TARGET
Image 1 is the assigned original source crop. Use it to preserve the forward-leaning walking silhouette from the source rather than inventing a generic upright stick person. Image 2 is the exact compact Japanese mock for this correction pass: use its green route marks, white background, six visible text elements, and composition.
The original source contains extra route details (fare, EW, walking counts, bus symbols, and English labels) that are absent from the mock and native node 2. The available records do not explain that reduction. Match the mock for this visual candidate, but do not treat the omission as approved or source-faithful; record the unresolved content gap separately.

EXACT 390×120 COMPOSITION
- Flat pure white background with no texture, diagonal shading, gradients, shadows or page frame.
- Walking icon at x20,y13, about 15×20; use the original forward-leaning person silhouette and recolor it green like the mock. Do not redraw it as an upright stick figure.
- Green rounded route badge 944 at x46,y12, 52×26, with white bold 14/24 digits.
- Dark arrow at x104,y12; green rounded 106 badge at x132,y12, 52×26.
- Set “50分” at x288,y14, around 86×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, ending near x374. Keep its position and size as in the mock; do not push it toward the far right edge.
- Set “出発 14:10” at x16,y72 in Meiryo Regular 14/24 and “到着 15:04” at x220,y72 in Meiryo Bold 14/24. Align both baselines to the mock and keep the right label within its intended bounds.
- Match the mock's compact size and whitespace. Keep all text and route graphics no larger or lower than shown in image 2.

VISIBLE COPY FOR THIS VISUAL CANDIDATE
出発 14:10 / 944 / → / 106 / 50分 / 到着 15:04.
Do not add map chrome or extra decorative elements. Do not change the green mock to purple: that direct correction applied only to LH13-0028. Keep source-only fare/EW/count details documented as unresolved in the review; do not claim full source fidelity.
reviewNotes: Attempt 2 selected for closer horizontal match. Source-only fare, EW, walking counts and transit markers remain omitted without a documented rationale; candidate also needs geometry and walking-icon correction.
